Scientists just sequenced a whale's complete genome using drones that caught mist from its blowhole! What if fleets of autonomous drones swept the oceans, sampling the breath of every living giant whale? By analyzing snot droplets, marine biologists could monitor entire oceanic species in real time without touching a single animal. We could spot underwater diseases early, combat illegal whaling, and unlock deep-sea survival secrets hidden inside whale DNA. Would you fly a drone into whale spray? Follow for more what-ifs.
